changelog:
0.3.18
- Fix: Settings > Changelog only shows the notes for the version actually installed (or, for a pending update, the version being installed), instead of every past release's notes concatenated together (github.com/mulai/slimeos#16).

0.3.17
- Fix: a Windows Brain reconnecting to its own previous disconnected RDP session (instead of a fresh one) could leave the Membrane stuck showing a quarter-size Brain picker until the whole Brain was rebooted — the hub now force-clears the stale session right after every clean disconnect (github.com/mulai/slimeos#17).
- Fix: NUC6CAxx (Celeron J3455) devices get a new dedicated hardware profile that switches to /gfx:AVC420 — xfreerdp3's AVC444 decode is single-threaded and was the real cause of choppy video playback on this board, not network or aggregate CPU (github.com/mulai/slimeos#14). Only shipped once #17 above was fixed, since switching codecs mid-session is exactly the kind of resize that could trigger it.

0.3.16
- New: "Brain display scaling" control in Settings > Display & Sound — fixes a large TV/monitor rendering a native-DPI desktop stretched across the whole screen (tiny icons/text), since Windows won't let you change Display settings from inside an RDP session itself (github.com/mulai/slimeos#15).

0.3.15
- Fix: capped the ALSA playback buffer used for Brain audio redirection, instead of letting FreeRDP request the hardware's maximum (up to ~11s on some onboard audio codecs) — stops residual audio lingering after stopping or adjusting volume on the Brain (github.com/mulai/slimeos#12).

0.3.14
- Fix: FreeRDP sessions now enable auto-reconnect globally, and profile 008 (Gigabyte 78LMT-S2P) falls back to /rfx, so a WiFi blip resumes the session instead of dropping it (github.com/mulai/slimeos#11).
- hardware-profiles/*.sh and detect.sh are now updated over-the-air like every other file, instead of requiring a reinstall.
